name: aurora-text

frames.best_why: The gradient word is clear and fully in view with the pointer kept away from it.

tagline: One word in a headline shimmers through pink, purple and blue.
summary: A span of text filled with a sliding pink-to-blue gradient that keeps drifting sideways, so a single word in a headline keeps catching the light.
appearance: A bold sans-serif heading on black made of three words. The first and last words are plain white, while the middle word is filled edge to edge with a pink, purple and blue gradient.
behaviour: The gradient slides slowly along the word and wraps around, so the pink, purple and blue bands keep travelling across the letters. It repeats without stopping.
demo_content: The heading Build beautiful apps. with the middle word in gradient.
use_when: One word in a headline should stand out with a moving colour highlight.
avoid_when: Body copy or long text; the cycling gradient distracts and hurts readability.
customise: Pass the word as children and set colors or speed; the gradient angle and the keyframe animation live in the source.
weight_why: A single text span with a repeating CSS background gradient.

a11y.note: The visual copy is hidden from assistive tech with a screen-reader duplicate, but the loop ignores reduced-motion.

polish_why: Bright, clean gradient on crisp type; the drift is subtle enough to stay classy.
title: Aurora Text
